purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: NARA AI Records and Compute Transition
question: How does NARA combine government-wide AI evidence custody with its own brokered hybrid cloud and archival-application stack?
bluf: NARA is both the government-wide records authority for federal AI evidence and a federal customer assembling a brokered hybrid stack: CTAC carries the cloud procurement rail; AWS is the largest named platform family and historically disclosed ERA 2.0 substrate; Azure carries EOP 46; Google supplies Workspace/Gemini and GCP/Vertex routes; and specialist integrators operate the archival applications above them.
entities: Office of the Chief Information Officer

classification.subsection: AI in government and the public record

availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Use the package finding as orientation, not as a substitute for the report.
Preserve the evidence cutoff. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Use public_reading materials directly. Treat private_library_metadata entries as existence and routing signals only.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
